title: Ethiopian Coffee Milkshake
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Coffee Milkshake — strong Yirgacheffe or Harrar espresso blended with vanilla ice cream, cardamom, and Ethiopian honey. The modern café treat — the birthplace-of-coffee nation's contribution to the global coffee shake tradition.
longDesc: Ethiopian coffee milkshake takes the extraordinary quality of Ethiopian arabica (Yirgacheffe or Harrar) and the cardamom tradition of Ethiopian spiced drinks into the global milkshake format — producing something extraordinary.
steps: Blend espresso, ice cream, milk, honey, and cardamom.
chefTips: Yirgacheffe espresso produces a floral, fruity shake; Harrar produces a chocolatey, winey shake.
Chill the espresso — hot espresso melts the ice cream too quickly.
cookingScience: Ethiopian arabica's high aromatic compound concentration (particularly floral terpenes from Yirgacheffe) survives the blending process well because the fat in the ice cream encapsulates the volatile aromatics, preserving them.
sustainabilityTips: Yirgacheffe or Harrar espresso — the world's finest single-origin coffees.
culturalNote: Ethiopian coffee milkshake is the Addis Ababa youth café's most photographed drink — the global milkshake format made from the world's finest coffee, in the country where coffee was born.
